aggregation_note: FAST MODE, not the median. Runs: 0.9 / 1.55 / 1.45 / 1.383 / 1.567. The published figure is the 0.900s run on the owner's instruction to take the faster side of a bimodal set: 0.900 sits 0.48s below a cluster that itself spans only 0.18s. Every other app publishes a median. Drafts is the only app that has BOTH per-run `ready` values and a bimodal split, so it is the only one the rule can be applied to — the six apps from the full run kept only median and range. If the rule is ever applied uniformly, Drafts' median is 1.450.
